title: 🎮 Final Friday Game Night
description:
End the month the best way possible: with pizza, games, and good company.
Join IRL Club on the last Friday of every month for a relaxed game night featuring Nintendo Switch games, classic favorites, friendly competition, and plenty of time to hang out.
Whether you're a serious gamer, a casual player, or someone who just wants a fun excuse to meet new people, you're welcome here. No gaming skills required—just bring yourself and a willingness to play.

Your ticket includes:
🍕 Pizza
🥤 Soda and refreshments
🎮 Nintendo Switch gaming
💻 Space for PC laptop gaming (bring your own laptop)
🎲 A variety of board and party games
✨ A casual, welcoming atmosphere
Details:
📅 Held on the last Friday of every month
🔞 Ages 18+
👋 Solo-friendly
Put down the phone, pick up a controller, and spend an evening playing together IRL.
